journeys.name: b8-tools-clock-endpoints
journeys.note: Both endpoints are free (no auth) and wall-clock derived: getNowTime is epoch ms, getTwelvemonth lists the previous 12 months from now. Java uses YearMonth.now() (JVM zone, ToolsController.java:39-46) and Rust OffsetDateTime::now_utc (main.rs:2317): different only around month boundaries in a non-UTC server zone. Compare shape only: nowTime masked as clock, twelvemonth NOT masked (stable except in the first hours of a month).
